data.name: WrongAgent
data.value: The snapshot address does not belong to the voice agent.

data.name: InvalidSnapshot
data.value: The voice persistence snapshot is missing or invalid.

data.name: SaveAlreadyAttempted
data.value: This connection already attempted persistence. Reconnect rather than replaying a potentially committed append.

data.name: InvalidArguments
data.value: Voice function arguments must be a JSON object.

data.name: UnsupportedMessage
data.value: The persisted voice message cannot be converted to a native conversation item.

data.name: AnonymousWarning
data.value: Voice session isolation is disabled: no AgentIsolationKeyProvider is registered. Anyone who knows a continuation id can resume its voice session.

data.name: MissingIdentity
data.value: A registered voice isolation provider did not return a key. The connection cannot be accepted.

data.name: SessionFailed
data.value: The voice session could not be initialized or completed. Reconnect with a new continuation id if its stored history is stale.

data.name: SaveFailed
data.value: Voice persistence failed or was partial. This continuation may be stale; do not automatically retry the turn.

data.name: ShutdownFailed
data.value: Voice processing did not stop within the shutdown budget. The incomplete conversation was not saved.

data.name: ToolFailed
data.value: The requested tool could not complete. Please try again later.
